title: Explorer navigation model
responsibility: Builds navigation destinations and revision controls within the displayed scope.

inputs.name: plainClick.event
inputs.description: Mouse event to test for application-handled navigation.

inputs.name: harnessShell.input
inputs.description: Navigation context with base, optional resolved scope/index, commits and address builder.

outputs.name: plainClick
outputs.description: True only for an unmodified primary-button click that has not already been prevented.

outputs.name: harnessShell
outputs.description: Brand destination, six category entries and optional revision controls. Categories retain branch/commit and clear entity context. Revision choices include the viewed commit when absent; branch changes select the tip or newest retained commit. Actual addresses come from the host’s href function.
